    - heading "AI-powered customer experience with Amazon Connect Customer" [level=1]
    - paragraph: Make every customer feel like your only customer. AI resolves interaction on its own, across any channel, with your team there for the moments that need a human.
    - button "Get started with Connect Customer"
    - button "Speak with an expert"
    - heading "What is Amazon Connect Customer?" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Amazon Connect Customer is an AI-powered customer experience solution, powering the full lifecycle of a customer’s interaction, from proactive outreach to self-service resolution to agent assistance, on any channel and at enterprise scale. Where most systems route and deflect, Connect Customer resolves what the customer came for, running on the same AWS infrastructure that handles millions of interactions a day.
    - paragraph: "It brings together everything a customer interaction needs in one solution: AI-powered conversations across voice and digital channels, agentic self-service that resolves requests on its own, real-time agent assist and manager assist, and customer intelligence that personalizes each interaction. It also orchestrates the work behind a resolution, such as refunds, disputes, and fraud checks, so context stays intact from first contact to final outcome. Governance, auditability, and data residency controls are built in from day one."
    - paragraph: On average in the first half of 2026, 23 million+ interactions occurred per day in Amazon Connect Customer.
    - paragraph:
      - text: Recognized by IDC in the
      - link "Worldwide Agentic Contact Center as a Service Platforms":
        - /url: /resources/analyst-reports/idc/global-ar-report-ardm-26-worldwide-agentic-contact-center-as-a-service-platforms/?trk=2a573d2c-bba9-4079-8047-ce6d453e1890&sc_channel=el
      - text: analyst report.
    - button "Play:"
    - img "Missing alt text value"
    - heading "How much does Amazon Connect Customer cost?" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Pay only for what you use
    - paragraph: Billed by channel, with no minimums and no long-term contracts. Voice $0.038/min, Chat $0.010/message, Email $0.080/message, SMS $0.014/message.
    - paragraph: AI and analytics included
    - paragraph: Agentic self-service and conversational analytics are included in the per-interaction price. There is no separate AI license or seat fee.
    - paragraph: AWS Free Tier eligible
    - paragraph: New AWS customers can start building on Free Tier-eligible resources.
    - paragraph:
      - link "Refer to the pricing page for more details":
        - /url: /products/connect/customer/pricing/appendix/?refid=5a5e1287-c028-4184-8719-3a5a862834a2
    - heading "What problems does Amazon Connect Customer solve?" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Most customer experience solutions route and deflect instead of resolving, so customers repeat themselves. Your team stays buried in routine work, and managers struggle to see what is going on. Connect Customer resolves the request itself, across any channel, and keeps context intact when a person needs to step in.
    - heading "Customers can’t get their issue resolved" [level=3]
    - img "aws-library_illustration_community_3_1200.jpg"
    - text: AI agents resolve requests on their own, such as returns, account updates, and rebookings. Customers can start on chat, switch to voice, and with Live Sync, they see the AI take action on screen in real time as they speak. Context follows across every channel, so they never start over.
    - link "Learn about omnichannel":
      - /url: /products/connect/customer/omnichannel/
    - heading "Routine and repetitive work keeps your team from the interactions that need them" [level=3]
    - img "aws-library_illustration_data_11_1200"
    - text: AI agents work alongside your people as teammates. They surface the right answer, recommend the next step, and complete after-contact work, so your team spends their time on the moments that need a human. When a customer escalates, full context follows, with no restart and no repeating.
    - link "Explore AI agents":
      - /url: /products/connect/customer/ai-agents/
    - heading "Managers struggle to get answers from their data" [level=3]
    - img "Missing alt text value"
    - text: Managers get a plain-language view of their operational data. They can ask what is happening, why, and what to do about it, and see conversations, trends, and coaching opportunities in real time, so they act on what matters before it escalates.
    - link "View full pricing":
      - /url: /products/connect/customer/pricing/appendix/
    - heading "How do I migrate from my current platform?" [level=2]
    - paragraph: A smooth transition to Amazon Connect Customer follows a structured process based on proven best practices, divided into key phases and milestones. Each phase plays a critical role in achieving a seamless migration.
    - heading "1. Design" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Business and IT leaders collaborate to create a future-driven architecture tailored to business needs. Create a robust, scalable architecture that seamlessly integrates business objectives with IT requirements and bring your existing AI agents into Connect Customer without rebuilding.
    - heading "2. Pre-Go-Live" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Focus on thorough preparation and planning, including testing, training, and documentation. Finalize configurations, conduct thorough testing, and prepare users for the new platform through end-user training and documentation.
    - heading "3. Go-Live" [level=3]
    - paragraph: The cutover happens, with rigorous verification to ensure stability.
    - heading "4. Post-Go-Live" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Monitor and optimize performance to ensure long-term success through continuous improvement.
    - link "Start now":
      - /url: https://signin.aws.amazon.com/signup?request_type=register&p=pdp&c=connect&s=1
    - heading "Is Amazon Connect Customer secure and compliant?" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Amazon Connect Customer keeps data, models, and conversation logic within one AWS trust boundary. It is HIPAA eligible, with support for PCI DSS, FedRAMP, SOC, ISO 27001, and GDPR.
    - paragraph: All data is encrypted at rest and in transit and stays in your chosen AWS Region. Every AI reasoning step is governed per turn, and every answer is auditable, controlled by role-based permissions that define who builds, which models are approved, and what the AI is allowed to say.
    - heading "What makes Amazon Connect Customer different?" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Amazon Connect Customer lets AI and people work together in whatever mix each interaction needs, from fully automated to fully human. It was built AI-first, so every capability ships natively rather than bolted onto older architecture. AI-powered self-service, real-time agent and manager assist, customer intelligence, and orchestration of the work behind a resolution run in one governed solution, not a stack of separate tools, with auditability, data residency controls, and guardrails built in from day one.
    - heading "Know your customer" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Connect Customer unifies customer data, interaction history, and real-time signals, so every channel acts on the same context. It identifies who is at risk and who is ready to buy before they ask and carries that context across voice and digital channels, so customers never repeat themselves.
    - heading "Design the experience" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Business and CX teams design and launch customer experiences in weeks, not months, without waiting on engineering. Conversations stay natural, while steps that must go exactly right, such as identity verification and compliance disclosures, run reliably every time. Teams that want full architectural control get the same speed through a developer-first path.
    - heading "Evolve with every conversation" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Every interaction feeds a shared intelligence that improves the next one. Connect Customer surfaces the patterns, friction points, and recurring requests that are invisible at scale, so the AI gets sharper and agents get better over time.

    - heading "How are customers using Amazon Connect Customer?" [level=2]
    - heading "Modernizing a legacy contact center" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Enterprises replace expensive, per-seat on-premises or legacy CCaaS platforms with Amazon Connect Customer to lower cost-to-serve, add omnichannel and AI capabilities, and remove the burden of managing telephony hardware and infrastructure.
    - heading "Scaling customer service without adding headcount" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Organizations use agentic self-service and AI agents to contain routine contacts automatically, deflecting volume from live agents while keeping resolution rates high, as seen with Zepz (67% self-service resolution) and Centrica (75% containment).
    - heading "Building regulated-industry CX solutions" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Banks, healthcare providers, and government agencies deploy on Amazon Connect Customer to meet PCI DSS, HIPAA, SOC, ISO 27001, and FedRAMP requirements with encryption, granular access control, and regional data residency.
